title: Compose terminal query retention into the five-stage complex supplier
body:
## Result

This PR composes the pinned PR233 source-assisted flow with the retained PR244 five-stage complex supplier by aligning each terminal center query with one retiring dirty coordinate.

The resulting complex profile has

```text
m = 110, W = 14,692, calls = 358,975
rank mass = 1,613,040, deficit = 3,080, max child = 46
```

Its moment certifies the conditional complex saving `754736418878859/10^18 = 0.000754736418878859`, compared with `747454944651775/10^18 = 0.000747454944651775` for the retained five-stage baseline (about 0.97417% greater complex-supplier saving).

## Construction

There are 22 terminal center queries, each the sum of nine independent physical coordinates. Eight additions replace one row of the identity by that query. The row replacement is invertible on arbitrary dirty data. Retain the pivot at rank 20 until the ordinary center cut, copy/read it, then execute its existing rank-2 final climb. Reverse the eight additions in cleanup.

This costs 176 forward additions and 176 inverse-cleanup subtractions. It adds no dirty roles, recursive children, or coefficient denominators. The complete five-stage ledger and the finite bill still include all center copies, source-K operations, ordinary target reads, dirty-response subtraction and inverse cleanup, routers, bridges, and endpoint operations.

## Claim boundary

This is a complex-supplier improvement only. The bit supplier still binds, so this PR claims **no improvement to assembled multiplication κ**. It also does not claim that the repository's current add-only parser or pinned Lean theorem checks the new scalar word. The construction is justified compositionally under the inherited exact frame, compiler, precision, and analytic interfaces. A monolithic global scalar transcript and new Lean admission are not included.

## Checks

The patch's portable commands are:

```sh
python3 -B research/terminal-query-retention/verify.py
python3 -B research/terminal-query-retention/verify_query_retention.py
python3 -B research/terminal-query-retention/two_port_screen.py
```

The first verifies the 22 selected sparse input/query identities, all 198 local dirty columns, the literal pivot operations, and the strict rational moment bound. `verify.py --flow PATH` additionally binds those rows to a full regenerated PR233 flow witness. The exact construction argument, independent critic review, profile, and receipts are included. The composition research log preserves the command chain for regenerating the original flow and rebuilding the allocator, source-K splice, finite bill, and profile; the full regenerated working tree is not vendored in this PR.

The baseline PR233 checks were rerun at `109a857a329d18ed5552d5573f17ddfa886ae57f`; the retained five-stage complex baseline is pinned to `a568d94f941929232ab393c7d33dc5a30e017892`. Main at the time of the experiment was `3b6b66891c0ac888521cf591fe306c6286601d4f`.

## Provenance

The PR233 source-assisted flow and the PR234/244 five-stage geometry retain their original attributions and notices. The new terminal-query composition and independent checks were prepared for SovereignSteak with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. This PR makes no exclusive priority or publication-novelty claim.
